correctness.rationale: The exact-support criterion is proved from kernel coordinate functionals and the finite-union-of-hyperplanes argument. Every one of 65,025 nonempty support-set pairs is decided with exact Q(zeta_8) ranks, and both stated symmetry orbit partitions are recomputed from the resulting realizable set.

value.rationale: The incidence multiplicity is a natural refinement of the published uncertainty diagram, quantifying support-location geometry that cardinality feasibility suppresses. The complete 8x8 matrix, 20,929 realizable pairs, and symmetry compression to 205/108 classes form a reusable benchmark for exact-support studies of higher prime powers; the large variation between feasible cells shows the invariant is not a cosmetic restatement of the size diagram.
